trial_court: Additional Principal Judge (Family Court), Hamirpur HP circuit Court at Barsar (HMA Petition no. 07/2018)
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The parties got married in 2004 and the husband is seeking dissolution of marriage on grounds of cruelty and desertion. The wife had earlier filed a petition under Section 125 of Cr.P.C and Section 12 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 against the husband and his family members.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging domestic violence to prove the same.
legal_principles.held: It also noted that there was a specific finding by the High Court in the said order in Criminal Revision petition no. 28 of 2013 that the respondent was subjected to domestic violence by the appellant and protection order was passed in her favour by the Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Barsar in petition no. 15-I of 2010 dt. 19.08.2011 which had also been upheld in the Criminal Revision petition no. 28 of 2013 dt. 18.07.2013.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: A party's readiness and willingness to join the company of the other party is an important factor in determining the nature of their relationship.
legal_principles.held: The Family Court noted that in the order Ext. P-3 passed in the complaint under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 filed by the respondent against the appellant and his parents on 19.08.2011, it is recorded that the appellant was not ready to take the respondent with him to his home.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

outcome.result: Appeal preferred by the appellant challenging the judgment dt. 30.12.2023 passed in HMA Petition no. 07/2018 of the Additional Principal Judge (Family Court), Hamirpur HP circuit Court at Barsar.
outcome.final_order: The appeal is reserved on 08.07.2024 and the date of decision is 16.07.2024.
